description: Contours administratifs des ports en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigloire.fr. Determines the administrative contour of a port, under the same port authority and grouping a land part and a water part. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Administrative contours of ports in Loire-Atlantique" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
